voiceSummary: ARSS Infrastructure Projects Limited published newspaper clippings regarding the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September 2026. The advertisement was published on Wednesday 11th November 2026 in Business Standard and Odisha Bhaskar. The company submitted this notice to the Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange of India Limited for information and records.

attchmntText: ARSS Infrastructure Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about increase in Authorised Capital
voiceSummary: ARSS Infrastructure Projects Limited held a Board Meeting on 10th November 2026 to approve Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Statutory Auditors issued a Qualified Conclusion on these results. The Board proposed increasing the Authorized Share Capital from 500 Crore Rupees to 1,100 Crore Rupees, subject to shareholder approval. The Board also placed before shareholders for approval material related party transactions with Ocean Capital Market Limited and Mr. Dipti Ranjan Patnaik. These transactions include the private placement of 5,00,00,000 and 50,00,00,000 Non-Cumulative Non-Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares to the respective parties. Additionally, the Board approved seeking shareholder approval for availing unsecured loans up to 100.00 Crore Rupees each from these related parties. A Postal Ballot Notice was approved with remote e-voting commencing on 17th November 2026 and ending on 16th December 2026. The cut-off date for determining voting rights is 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: ARSS Infrastructure Projects Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: ARSS Infrastructure Projects Limited held a Board Meeting on 10th November 2026. The Board approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Statutory Auditors issued a Qualified Conclusion. The qualification relates to unresolved arbitration claims of Rs. 70,831.96 Lakhs and the classification of a loan from Ocean Capital Market Limited. The Board also approved an increase in Authorized Share Capital from Rs. 500 Crore to Rs. 1,100 Crore. This increase is subject to shareholder approval. The Board approved material related party transactions with Ocean Capital Market Limited and Mr. Dipti Ranjan Patnaik. These transactions are subject to shareholder approval. The Board approved the issue of 5,00,00,000 preference shares to Ocean Capital Market Limited. The Board approved the issue of 50,00,00,000 preference shares to Mr. Dipti Ranjan Patnaik. Both issues are subject to shareholder approval. The Board approved unsecured loans up to Rs. 100.00 crore each from these related parties. These loans are subject to shareholder approval. A Postal Ballot Notice was approved. The cut-off date for voting is 13th November 2026. Remote e-voting commences on 17th November 2026. Remote e-voting ends on 16th December 2026.

attchmntText: ARSS Infrastructure Projects Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Committee Meeting held on November 06, 2026 with respect to allotment of securities
voiceSummary: ARSS Infrastructure Projects Limited has allotted 25,00,00,000 Non-Convertible Non-Cumulative Redeemable Preference Shares to Ocean Capital Market Limited. The allotment was approved by the Share Allotment Committee on 6th November 2026. Each share has a face value of Rs. 10. The total subscription amount received is Rs. 250,00,00,000. The shares are unlisted and unsecured. The tenure is 22 months from the date of allotment. The expected maturity date is 5th September 2028. A dividend rate of 0.01% per annum applies if declared by the Board. Redemption will occur at maturity. The redemption value includes the face value and a premium to provide an internal rate of return of 12% per annum. The redemption will be made from profits or fresh issue proceeds as per the Companies Act 2013.
